title: Task Scheduler
description: Given a characters array `tasks`, representing CPU tasks, and an integer `n` as cooling interval between two same tasks, return the minimum number of units of times that the CPU will take to finish all the given tasks.
input_format: First line contains total tasks `m` and cooling interval `n`. Second line contains space-separated task characters.

sample_tests.input:
6 2
A A A B B B
sample_tests.explanation: A -> B -> idle -> A -> B -> idle -> A -> B.

sample_tests.input:
6 0
A A A B B B

6 2
A A A A A B

hints: The most frequent tasks define the skeleton: `(max_freq - 1) * (n + 1) + max_count`.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    m, n = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    tasks = data[2:2+m]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(tasks)
    max_freq = max(counts.values())
    max_count = sum(1 for c in counts.values() if c == max_freq)
    ans = max(len(tasks), (max_freq - 1) * (n + 1) + max_count)
    print(ans)
